test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

I was always greeted ______ wherever I went in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is: **warmly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence requires an adverb to describe how the speaker was greeted.
 
• "**Warmly**" is the correct adverb form of "warm".
 
• A
